description: Validate a single IBAN. Spaces, including leading and trailing spaces, are accepted and removed before checking the IBAN format, checksum and available bank/account details. Required parameter: iban. Counts as one IBAN-Test API request. Authentication is required for execution; anonymous clients may discover this tool. Register or log in to create an API key: https://www.iban-test.eu/Registration. Configured free limit: 10 API requests per 24-hour period.
name: validate_iban
